decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=REPLY, dst=/net/downlink/a/net/downlink/cli/reply-ep, src=/sensor/temp, kind=RESULT, payload=VALUE u32=1234 } — the reply exactly as the TERMINUS emits it: the request's routes swapped (reply dst = request src, the accumulated return route; reply src = request dst, the responder's own address), source-routed home over both mount runs
decoded.note: RFC-0004 §B/§C canonical bytes; structured TLV, opt.PL=1, no trailers (at-rest form). Bytes CHANGED 2026-08-02 by maintainer ruling (c) — the previous dst=/via_board/via_net/reply-ep was pre-S2a and did not compose under mount routing (protocol DRAFT).
